translationRepairs: When Emperor Wuzong raised troops in the northern steppe, Yahudou asked that his son Tele Temür accompany him.
When Emperor Wuzong raised troops in the northern steppe, he asked that Yahudou's son Tele Temür accompany him.

In s0084, 武宗 is the subject of 撫兵 and continues as the subject of 請; the idiomatic wrongly makes Yahudou the requester, while the repair correctly has Wuzong ask that Yahudou's son Tele Temür accompany him.
Yan Temür succeeded at the age of twelve. His consort was of the Kongirat clan, granddaughter of the consort of Prince Haqar and a cousin of Empress Sugeshili.
Yan Temür succeeded at the age of twelve. His consort was of the Kongirat clan, granddaughter of the imperial son-in-law Haqar and a cousin of Empress Sugeshili.
哈只兒駙馬 names Haqar as an imperial son-in-law (駙馬); the idiomatic misreads this as the consort of a Prince Haqar, and the proposed replacement is accurate.
